architecture:
## Games on Android — architecture

### Placement and navigation
- **Games becomes the 7th bottom destination** (`PocketDjDestination.Games("games", "Games", phase=5, Icons.Filled.SportsEsports)`), inserted after Jukebox to mirror iOS order (Browser · History · Collections · Mix · Producer · Jukebox · Games). Seven labelled items do not fit a 411 dp Pixel at 10 sp, so `NavigationBar` items switch to `alwaysShowLabel = false` (label only on the selected item). This is a **shared touchpoint** on `navigation/PocketDjDestination.kt` + `MainActivity.kt`; if the surfaces architect replaces the bar with a rail/overflow, the only requirement from Games is that route `games` and the pushed routes below are reachable.
- Pushed routes (in `MainActivity.kt`, constants exported from `screens/games/GamesRoutes.kt`): `games/puzzle`, `games/puzzle/genres`, `games/inthepocket`, `games/mwf/{sessionId}`. Titles handled like the existing `title = when (currentRoute)` table.
- All game engines are **app-scoped singletons** in a `GamesGraph` sidecar (`di/GamesGraph.kt`, the `JukeboxGraph` pattern) hanging off `AppGraph`, so a running round survives tab switches and screen pops (the iOS SetlistPlayer/MixEngine doctrine). `GamesGraph.get(context)` is the only entry; AppGraph itself is not edited.

### Packages (Kotlin)
```

com.levi.pocketdj.data.games.puzzle     PuzzleSettings, PlayRecency, PuzzleSampler, PuzzleSimilarity, PuzzleDecisionStore, PuzzleRecEventBridge, CollectorsPuzzleEngine
com.levi.pocketdj.data.games.inthepocket InThePocketModels, InThePocketScorer, InThePocketMembership, InThePocketLearning, SplitMix64, InThePocketRoundEvaluator, InThePocketStore, InThePocketRoundsClient
com.levi.pocketdj.data.games.friends    MwFLink, MwFModels, MwFClient, MwFJoinSecret, MusicWithFriendsStore, MwFSessionFile
com.levi.pocketdj.data.pockets          PocketsModels (ListeningContextTag, PocketsResults v1 lenient decode), PocketsBridge (interface + NoPocketsBridge)   ← shared with the services area
com.levi.pocketdj.playback              GameRunPlayer (interface) + Media3GameRunPlayer (adapter), SkipTracker, PlayProgress events   ← shared touchpoints

### Data flow
```
PlaybackService ──PlayStarted/PlayProgress──▶ PlayEventBus ──▶ PlayHistoryStore (record / markSkipped / noteListened)

### Key classes and contracts
- **GameRunPlayer** (new, `playback/GameRunPlayer.kt`): `suspend fun playRun(items: List<RunItem>, context: PlayContext): RunStart` (RunItem{songId,title,artist,lengthMs}; returns how many items resolved), `suspend fun appendRun(items, context)` (appends ONLY when `ownsRun(context.contextId)`), `fun ownsRun(tag): Boolean`, `suspend fun queueIndex(): Int?`, `suspend fun stopRun(tag)` (no-op unless owned), `val nowPlaying: StateFlow`. `Media3GameRunPlayer` lives beside `PlaybackController` and needs three small additions to `PlaybackController` (shared touchpoint, ≈50 lines): `suspend fun appendQueue(items: List<MediaItem>)`, `suspend fun currentQueueIndex(): Int?`, and an `internal fun buildGameItem(songId, url, song, album, context, isPreview)` that reuses the private `mediaItem()`. **Decision — game runs are ExoPlayer-only**: manifest hits stream; a non-manifest song with an `appleMusicId` rides as the 30-s AM preview (`AppleMusicPreviewResolver`, emulator-OK, cached per id); full-track AM (one-song-at-a-time native engine) is never used inside a game queue because the engine maps its queue index onto the player's. Rip-on-demand is excluded (a timed rush cannot wait minutes). The adapter resolves preview URLs in chunks of 12 ahead of the cursor; an unresolvable song is **dropped from the ROUND queue before it is shown** (`audioResolvable` hook on the engine), preserving the "a card on screen is a song you can hear" contract.
- **History attribution** (shared touchpoint, history area): `PlaySource.GAME("game", label "Game")`, `PlayContext.SOURCE_GAME`, `PlayContext.game(runTag, gameLabel)`; `PlaybackService` already forwards the context extras, so rows read "Game · Gem Collector" with no service change.
- **SkipTracker + verdict fields** (shared touchpoint, playback/history — package GAMES-6, yield to the playback architect if they claim it): `PlayEvent` gains `wasSkipped: Boolean? = null`, `listenedFraction: Double? = null`, `tzOffsetMin: Int? = null`, `originInstallId: String? = null` (additive-optional, same iOS key names); `PlayHistoryStore.record` stamps tz + originInstallId and returns the event id; `markSkipped(eventId)` / `noteListened(eventId, fraction)` (clamped, MAX-merged, <1 pp changes dropped, no PlayStarted re-fire); `PlaybackService` emits `PlayProgress(songId, positionMs, durationMs)` every ~1 s and `PlayAdvancedAway(songId, positionMs?, durationMs?)` from `onMediaItemTransition` with reason SEEK/PLAYLIST_CHANGED (never AUTO = natural end) and from `stop()/clearMediaItems`; `SkipTracker` keeps the iOS rule (strict <0.5, high-water position, one-deep previous stash) and writes verdicts.
- **PocketsBridge** (`data/pockets/PocketsBridge.kt`): `val isEnabled: StateFlow<Boolean>` (recEngineEnabled && listeningPocketsEnabled), `val results: StateFlow<PocketsResults?>`, `suspend fun refreshIfStale()`, `fun flushSoon()`, `var roundsProvider: ((installId) -> List<InThePocketRoundWire>)?`, `suspend fun credentials(): Pair<key, profileId>?`, `val installId`. `NoPocketsBridge` (default until the services wave lands) is disabled → the game shows the opt-in screen in a "needs Recommendations + Listening pockets in Settings" state. `InThePocketRoundsClient` (Games-owned) posts `rounds.v1` batches of ≤50 to `${Endpoints.LISTENING_POCKETS_BASE}/pockets/rounds` with the bridge's bearer key + `X-PocketDJ-Profile`, acknowledges fingerprints only on 2xx, marks `roundsServiceAvailable=false` on 404 (rounds stay queued), persists `sentRounds` in a device-local `pocketdj-in-the-pocket-sync.json`.
- **PocketsResults** decode: lenient per-element (bad element ⇒ dropped, not the document), `algo.version` nested, `rounds` ⇒ roundLearning, numeric map per-key lenient — a Kotlin `JsonElement` walker, not `@Serializable` data classes, to match the iOS `LPKey` tolerance.
- **Collections inputs**: `CollectionsStore.songIdsForPocket/Playlist`, `playlistContains`, `createPocket(name, songIds, description)`, `addSongToPocket`, `addSong(songId, AddTarget)`; "all collection memberships" for similarity = every pocket/playlist flattened (memoised on `CollectionsStore.state.revision` inside the engine, never recomputed in the ticker). Add times for membership recency come from `CollectionActivityStore.events` (ADD kind, itemId=songId) — unknown ⇒ 0.75.
- **Favorites / rec feedback / cloud similar**: provider seams on the engine defaulting to empty (`favoriteIdsProvider`, `recSuppressedProvider`, `cloudSimilarProvider`); wired when the favorites store (deferred per android/specs/activity-favorites.md) and the Android rec engine exist. The round is byte-identical to today's sampling when they are empty (the iOS contract).

### Persistence (shape-compatible with iOS)
| Doc | Android path | Shape |
|---|---|---|
| pocketdj-game-scores.json | filesDir | `{schemaVersion:1, installId, runs:[RunRecord], deleted?:[Tombstone]}` — key `deleted` omitted when empty |
| pocketdj-puzzle-decisions.json | filesDir | `{schemaVersion:1, installId, decisions:[Decision]}` |
| pocketdj-in-the-pocket.json | filesDir (device-local, excluded from backup via `backup_rules.xml`) | `{schemaVersion:1, rounds:[Round], currentRoundId?}` |
| pocketdj-in-the-pocket-sync.json | filesDir | `{sentRounds:{id:fingerprint}}` |
| pocketdj-mwf-sessions.json | filesDir | `[MwFSessionEntry]` (same field names as iOS UserDefaults blob) |
| pocketdj-games.preferences_pb | DataStore | puzzleSettingsJson, mwfJoinSecret, mwfScoredSessionIds (string set), mwfQueueAccepted, mwfDisplayName |
Ids are UUID strings; `at`/`playedAt` epoch-ms **Double** (iOS wire). Every write: temp file + rename (the PlayHistoryStore idiom). All documents use `PdjJson.lenient` EXCEPT the rounds wire, which uses a Json with `explicitNulls = true` (server `cleanRound` tolerates nulls; iOS encodes them).

### Threading model
- Engine/store state = `StateFlow<ImmutableSnapshot>`; mutations run on `Dispatchers.Main.immediate` (iOS @MainActor equivalent) via a `mainScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main.immediate)` inside GamesGraph. Heavy work (sampling over ~100k songs, similarity profile, scorer, JSON encode of MB-scale docs) runs in `withContext(Dispatchers.Default)` on COW-style immutable snapshots taken on Main (the iOS `RawInputs` → `Inputs(raw:)` split).
- Tickers: `while (isActive) { tickOnce(); delay(250) }` (puzzle) / `delay(1000)` (ITP) launched in `mainScope`; tests call `tickOnce()`/`evaluate()` directly (`countdownEnabled=false`, injected `now`, `rng`).
- PuzzleDecisionStore writer: `Dispatchers.IO.limitedParallelism(1)` + an `AtomicInteger` write generation; `flush()` on `ProcessLifecycleOwner` STOP via a lifecycle observer registered in GamesGraph.
- MwF: one `refresh(id)` loop per open session screen (`LaunchedEffect(sessionId)`, 4 s, breaks when ended), all verbs `suspend` on IO through `MwFClient`.

### Platform APIs
- Media3 `MediaController` (queue index, `addMediaItems`, transitions) — already the one audio owner.
- `android.speech.SpeechRecognizer.createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer` + `isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable` + `EXTRA_PREFER_OFFLINE` for dictation; `RECORD_AUDIO` permission via `ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission`; partial results appended to the typed base.
- Deep links: manifest `<intent-filter>` VIEW/BROWSABLE for `pocketdj://mwf/*` and `https://jukebox.pocket-dj.com/mwf/*` (`android:autoVerify="true"`; needs assetlinks.json server-side), `MainActivity.onNewIntent` → `friends.handleOpenedLink`; `pendingOpenId` consumed by `PocketDjApp` (navigate to Games then push the session when an entry exists).
- ZXing (`JukeboxQrCard`) for the invite QR; `Intent.ACTION_SEND` share; `ClipboardManager` copy.
- No WorkManager/Glance needed in this area.

### Mix DSP engine
Not touched by this area — no decision made here.

### Invariants carried over (must stay true on Android)
1. One point per filed card; one decision row per target; cancel ≠ skip; endFiling idempotent; live-membership re-check.
2. Clock hold while the picker is open; credit = min(elapsed, 20 + 10·extraTargets) ≤ 60 s.
3. Audio is authoritative for position; expired rows persisted in one batch; watchdog re-arms once per card; never skip/stop/append into a foreign run; takeover ends the round without touching their audio; top-up is single-flight and round-guarded.
4. Playable-first pool with fallback on the result; rip-on-demand is not playable; similarity off/no-targets ⇒ byte-identical sampling; starvation guard.
5. GameKind tokens frozen; tombstoned deletes; cap trim never tombstones; `deleted` omitted when empty.
6. Only `assigned` decisions ever leave the device.
7. In the Pocket: rounds device-local; only finished rounds upload; floored minutes; fingerprint re-send; queued on 404; opaque context only; labels never uploaded; feedback ≤2000 UTF-16 units; dictation on-device only; evaluator constants (settle 8 s, idle 3 h, tolerance 2 s, 0.9/0.5 fractions); scorer constants + algoVersion 1 + SplitMix64; learning formula identical to analyze.mjs.
8. MwF: joinSecret ≠ install id; 401 recovery order (memberKey, then secret); 404/410 fold; score recorded once; per-session error channels; create/join errors stay in the sheet; never auto-queue into a live puzzle round; theme ≤144; preview debounce + stale guard.
decisions: Games is a 7th bottom-nav destination placed after Jukebox (iOS order); NavigationBar switches to label-on-selected-only (alwaysShowLabel=false) so seven items fit a 411 dp phone. Surfaces architect may swap in a rail/overflow; Games only needs route `games` reachable.
Game engines live in a GamesGraph sidecar (JukeboxGraph pattern) with Main.immediate state mutation + Default-dispatcher heavy work, instead of editing AppGraph.

Game runs are ExoPlayer-only: manifest streams first, 30-second Apple Music previews for non-manifest songs with an appleMusicId (emulator-OK), never the native AM full-track engine inside a game queue (it is single-song and would break queue-index ownership); unresolvable songs are dropped from the round queue before they are shown.
History gains PlaySource.GAME / PlayContext.game(runTag, label) (shared touchpoint) so rows read 'Game · Gem Collector' exactly as iOS; the token is additive and lenient-safe.

Skip/fraction verdicts (SkipTracker, wasSkipped/listenedFraction/tzOffsetMin/originInstallId on PlayEvent, PlayProgress/PlayAdvancedAway events from PlaybackService) are specified as package GAMES-6 because In the Pocket cannot ship without them; the playback architect may claim it, in which case GAMES-6 collapses into a dependency with the same contract.

In the Pocket depends on a PocketsBridge interface (enabled gate, results, credentials, flushSoon, roundsProvider) that the services area implements; Games ships a NoPocketsBridge so the game compiles and shows the opt-in/unavailable state, and owns the POST /pockets/rounds client half.

In the Pocket on Android runs time-only (ctx = null) — the Location engine port is out of Games scope and flagged for the collections/services architect; the ListeningContextTag model is still defined (shared file data/pockets/PocketsModels.kt) for wire/results compatibility.
Scoreboard keeps the iOS JSON shape including tombstones and the pure union-merge (tested) even though no sync exists yet, so a future S3 profile sync can merge across platforms without a migration.

Music with Friends ships without push (broker is APNs-only; polling is the source of truth on iOS too); catalog-only matching for leader approvals (AM catalog search is a later rung); unresolved downloaded-collection entries are counted and skipped rather than materialised as provisional songs (no portable-items path on Android).

AddToCollectionSheet gains optional onAdded + stayOpenAfterAdd parameters (≈15 lines, collections architect's file) so Gem Collector's multi-collection filing works; default behaviour unchanged for every other caller.
The rounds wire uses a dedicated Json with explicitNulls=true (server contract encodes nulls); every on-disk document keeps PdjJson.lenient.
No CloudKit/UI-fixture seams are ported; stores take injectable File paths for JVM tests and a debug-only seed intent extra replaces PDJ_SEED_GAMES for emulator drives.
